summary_text: The user exhibits a stable, high-frequency purchasing pattern centered on breakfast and meal-preparation staples, specifically Milk, Breads, and Vegetables. These three categories co-occur repeatedly across multiple independent dates in May, June, and July 2026, forming a consistent 'staple triad' for daily sustenance. Milk is the dominant anchor, appearing in the vast majority of orders across all months. Breads and Vegetables serve as reliable companions, often purchased together or with Milk. While the user also purchases ritual items (Incense Sticks, Pooja Flowers) and snacks (Savouries, Chocolates), these do not form stable, recurring bundles with the core staples. Ordering behavior is predominantly weekday morning, though afternoon and evening orders occur. Basket composition is generally moderate, focusing on fresh daily needs rather than bulk stock-ups.
